findings.summary: Luna's eight-product current catalog is materially incomplete: the live official-linked Toast menu contains a broad all-day catalog, including many frozen-item matches and current-only products such as Teriyaki Hash and Loaded Tots.
The scout omitted the official Catering Menu and used a stale drinks-PDF identifier. The food PDF/API cannot currently establish a complete restaurant-issued menu boundary.

Frozen official-ingredients claims cannot be sustained from the accessible evidence. Toast descriptions are restaurant-linked-vendor partial positive ingredient evidence only; absent allergens, complete arrays, and cross-contact conclusions remain unavailable. Luna's chicken-wings may-contain soy claim is semantically unsupported.
Frozen row 44:from is an extraction artifact; many remaining frozen rows contain stale, malformed, duplicated, or variant labels and cannot be treated as exact restaurant-issued current products.

verifier.summary: Identity is verified, but Luna's catalog verification is materially incomplete and cannot support a clean outcome. The official-linked Toast menu contains many products Luna missed, the official Catering Menu was omitted, the exact drinks PDF has changed, and restaurant-issued PDF/API scope is unresolved. No complete authoritative allergen or cross-contact source was found; retained positives are narrow restaurant-linked-vendor description evidence only.
